message: Hey! My name is Biy-Ae and I am glad to meet you. You can call me by the shorter form of "Biy". It's a nice nickname for someone who has an easygoing personality. Enjoy your day!

Yes, that's right. Your name is John and it's a great choice. You have a charming personality and a friendly outlook on life. Join us in welcoming you to the family! Welcome aboard! Enjoy your journey!
